scripts.query: CREATE OR REPLACE DICTIONARY profiler_race_dict ( `key` String, `value` String ) PRIMARY KEY key SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(USER 'dict_source_user' PASSWORD '' QUERY `SELECT toString(number) AS key, toString(number) AS value FROM numbers(3000000)`)) LIFETIME(MIN 0 MAX 0) LAYOUT(COMPLEX_KEY_HASHED) SETTINGS(dictionary_lazy_load = 0);
